sections.heading: Using Irregular Verbs
paragraphs: Some Hungarian verbs are irregular, meaning their forms change and do not follow the regular conjugation patterns.

Common irregular verbs include: lesz (will be), tesz (does), vesz (takes), hisz (believes), visz (carries), eszik (eats), iszik (drinks), megy (goes), jön (comes), játszik (plays), vacsorázik (has dinner).
You will often use these verbs in everyday conversations about hobbies and free time.

sections.heading: Hobbies and Free Time Vocabulary
paragraphs: You can combine these verbs with hobbies and activities to describe what people do in their free time.
